surface_score_basis: Main bootstrap and link/drift gates are correct; operator env and bootstrap sentences drift.

findings.claim: CLI reference tells operators to set BIOETL_TRACING_ENABLED, and Settings ignores that name.
findings.broken_invariant: Documented operator environment variables match Settings env_prefix and nested delimiter.
findings.root_cause: Flat tracing env name is not a Settings field or alias; tracing is nested observability.tracing_enabled.
findings.expected: Docs name BIOETL_OBSERVABILITY__TRACING_ENABLED, which sets observability.tracing_enabled.
findings.actual: cli.md:1578 and cli-commands.md:691 document BIOETL_TRACING_ENABLED. Probe: flat name tracing_nested=False; nested name tracing_nested=True.
findings.impact: Operator enables tracing with the documented variable and tracing stays off.
findings.remediation: Replace BIOETL_TRACING_ENABLED with BIOETL_OBSERVABILITY__TRACING_ENABLED in both tables. Do not apply until approved.
findings.acceptance: rg BIOETL_TRACING_ENABLED docs/04-reference/cli.md docs/03-guides/cheatsheets/cli-commands.md returns no matches; both tables use BIOETL_OBSERVABILITY__TRACING_ENABLED.

findings.claim: running-pipelines.md and the CLI env tables say BIOETL_METRICS_ENABLED turns metrics on or off, but the runtime gate is observability.metrics_enabled.
findings.broken_invariant: The documented metrics switch is the field the metrics bootstrap reads.
findings.root_cause: Root Settings.metrics_enabled is a separate field from ObservabilitySettings.metrics_enabled, and bootstrap prefers the nested field.
findings.observation: BIOETL_METRICS_ENABLED=false sets only the root flag; nested metrics stay enabled.
findings.expected: How-to uses BIOETL_OBSERVABILITY__METRICS_ENABLED, already documented in metrics-monitoring.md.
findings.actual: Probe flat BIOETL_METRICS_ENABLED=false -> metrics_root False, metrics_nested True. Nested BIOETL_OBSERVABILITY__METRICS_ENABLED=false -> metrics_nested False.
findings.impact: Operators following the running guide cannot disable metrics with the command they are given.
findings.remediation: Point the running-pipelines snippet and CLI tables at BIOETL_OBSERVABILITY__METRICS_ENABLED. Leave metrics-monitoring.md as the matching how-to. Do not apply until approved.
findings.acceptance: running-pipelines.md and both CLI tables use BIOETL_OBSERVABILITY__METRICS_ENABLED for the on/off switch.

findings.claim: environment-variables.md lists BIOETL_ENV modes dev, test, prod, and Settings rejects test.
findings.broken_invariant: Published environment mode list equals Settings.env Literal.
findings.root_cause: The partial env reference was not updated when the allowed set became dev, staging, prod.
findings.observation: Settings(env='test') raises ValidationError; env='staging' is accepted by the type.
findings.actual: environment-variables.md:12 says dev, test, prod. cli.md:1573 says dev, prod and omits staging. Probe rejected env=test.
findings.impact: An operator who sets BIOETL_ENV=test from the reference fails settings validation at startup.
findings.remediation: Replace the mode list with dev, staging, prod in environment-variables.md and cli.md. Do not apply until approved.
findings.acceptance: Neither active reference lists test as a BIOETL_ENV mode; both list staging.

findings.claim: The env reference calls the OpenAlex API key an optional rate-limit upgrade, while the provider page requires it for production-like runs.
findings.broken_invariant: One operator contract for whether BIOETL_OPENALEX_API_KEY is required.
findings.root_cause: environment-variables.md understates the provider contract and does not mention the legacy mailto-only adapter path.
findings.observation: Required column is No and the description is higher rate limits; publication.md says the key is required and email does not replace it.
findings.method: file inspection of both docs and OpenAlex adapter creator
findings.expected: Partial env reference matches the provider page: key required for production-like runs; email is attribution only.
findings.actual: environment-variables.md:26 Required=No, higher rate limits. publication.md:172-174 and :272 Required=Да. Adapter raises ValueError only when both api_key and mailto are missing (_client_support.py:95-99).
findings.impact: An operator can omit the key after reading the env reference and still miss the production boundary stated by the provider page.
findings.remediation: Rewrite the OpenAlex rows to match publication.md, and add one clause that mailto-only construction remains a legacy adapter fallback, not the production boundary. Do not apply until approved.
findings.acceptance: environment-variables.md OpenAlex rows match publication.md:169-174 and state the legacy mailto fallback explicitly.

findings.claim: running-pipelines.md presents the tracing uv extra set and make install as the same canonical bootstrap.
findings.broken_invariant: How-to bootstrap commands match the Makefile install target and the quick-start distinction.
findings.root_cause: The running guide collapsed two documented extra sets into one sentence.
findings.observation: Makefile install syncs dev, tests, tests_full, export. quick-start says that set is not the tracing minimal set.
findings.method: Read Makefile install target and both guides
findings.expected: running-pipelines.md names both sets separately, as quick-start.md:50-55 does.
findings.actual: Line 59-60 joins `uv sync --extra dev --extra tests --extra tracing` and `make install` with a slash as one canonical bootstrap. Makefile:99-100 is `uv sync --extra dev --extra tests --extra tests_full --extra export`.
findings.impact: An operator can install the tracing set and believe architecture/export extras from make install are present, or the reverse.
findings.remediation: Replace the slash sentence with the two explicit extra sets from quick-start.md. Do not apply until approved.
findings.acceptance: running-pipelines.md no longer equates the tracing extra set with make install.

findings.claim: BIOETL_LOG_LEVEL is documented as a core setting and is not read by Settings or any Python module.
findings.broken_invariant: A variable listed as a key local setting exists on Settings or in .env.example.
findings.root_cause: Log level is a CLI/context default, and the env name was documented without a Settings field.
findings.observation: Settings has no log_level attribute. Repository Python sources do not reference BIOETL_LOG_LEVEL. .env.example has no such key.
findings.method: Settings probe hasattr log_level False; ripgrep BIOETL_LOG_LEVEL under src and .env.example
findings.expected: Docs either remove the variable or point at the real log-level control.
findings.actual: getting-started.md:159, environment-variables.md:14, cli.md:1575, cli-commands.md:688, metrics-monitoring.md:119 list BIOETL_LOG_LEVEL default INFO. Probe has_log_level False.
findings.impact: Setting BIOETL_LOG_LEVEL=DEBUG in .env does not change log verbosity.
findings.remediation: Remove BIOETL_LOG_LEVEL from the core tables or label it unused and point to the CLI debug flag. Confirm the intended control before editing. Do not apply until approved.
findings.acceptance: Active docs no longer present BIOETL_LOG_LEVEL as a working Settings variable unless a reader is added in code.

findings.claim: cli-commands.md says make test-deps installs test-only dependencies.
findings.broken_invariant: Make target descriptions match the Makefile recipe.
findings.root_cause: The cheatsheet verb was not updated when the target became an import check.
findings.observation: Makefile test-deps runs python -c import of pytest, pytest_cov, pytest_asyncio, hypothesis, vcr.
findings.expected: Use when: check that test dependencies import.
findings.impact: Running only make test-deps does not install missing test packages.
findings.remediation: Change the Use when cell to a presence check. Do not apply until approved.
findings.acceptance: cli-commands.md no longer says make test-deps installs packages.
